requirements.requirement: Configure a backend on node1 TCP port 8091 that returns exactly `backend-ready`.
requirements.summary: The backend listened on TCP 8091 and returned the required body before and after node restart.

requirements.requirement: Publish the backend through a reverse proxy on TCP port 8090.
requirements.summary: Nginx listened on TCP 8090 and returned `backend-ready`. Post-restart nginx and backend logs directly correlate a request on 8090 with forwarding to the backend on 127.0.0.1:8091.

overall_summary: Both material task outcomes are satisfied with direct pre- and post-restart behavioral evidence. The sole-node restart protocol is strong: it records healthy tasked services and responses under the original boot identity, restart acknowledgement, a different boot identity corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, and recovered services, listeners, response data, and proxy-chain behavior.
limitations: All HTTP probes originated on node1 using its managed address; no separate external-client reachability test was captured, although all-interface listeners were directly observed.

The node-wide system state was degraded because ssh.service was already failed before execution and remained failed afterward. Thus the restart evidence establishes recovery of the tasked services and data, not a globally failure-free node.

operational_hygiene.summary: Implementation was focused and package health remained intact, but two unnecessary exposures remained. The backend unit bound 8091 to all interfaces even though the local proxy used loopback; this retained broader access than necessary (cmd-190cb6f63c584515). Installing and starting nginx without disabling its packaged default site also retained unsolicited listeners on TCP 80 (cmd-8bd41bb24a9446ad, cmd-fa5809a1a2a34559). Both exposures are confirmed in the final socket snapshot. No reverted unnecessary mutations were identified; the failed initial installation has no evidence of changing package state, and the update, reboot, and probe-generated logs had clear task or evidence roles.
